## About
Jerry Ernst started this shop on Kellogg Avenue near Lunken Airport. When Jerry decided it was time to retire, Greg Smith, who had been working with him, wanted to keep the family business going. Now Greg Smith and his family run Jerry Ernst Collision Center.
We're a full service collision repair center and auto body shop. Our technicians and staff repair all vehicle makes and models, and we stand behind the work with a lifetime warranty on all services.
Some of the people you might meet are TJ Qvick at the front, Mike Hauser on estimates, and Scott Summers on detailing and quality control. Customers have given us 4.7 stars from 89 Google reviews.

## Services
- Full Service Collision Repair: From the first inspection through reassembly and a final quality check, we take care of the whole repair.
- Automotive Refinishing: Base coat/clear coat refinishing on all vehicle makes and models.
- Precision Frame/Unibody Repairs: We inspect the inner structural components and use our computerized measuring system where applicable.
- Door Dings & Small Dent Repair: Parking lot dings and small dents taken care of.
- Wheel Repair & Replacement: Damaged wheels repaired or replaced.
- Auto Glass & Windshield Repair: Glass and windshield work as part of your repair.
- Lease Return Repairs: Get your car ready before it goes back.
- Pickup, Delivery & Towing: We can pick up your car, and you too.

## FAQ
Q: Do I need an appointment for an estimate?
A: No. Estimate appointments are offered for convenience, but you're welcome to just come by.

Q: Will you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. We accept all car insurance plans, and we can help you file your claim if you need to. If you're paying out of pocket, we can help with that too.

Q: How will I get around while my car is in the shop?
A: We can arrange alternative transportation for you during the repairs.

Q: Can I come in early, late or on a Saturday?
A: Yes, by appointment. Give us a call and we'll set it up.

Q: Where are you located?
A: We're on Kellogg Avenue, five miles east of Downtown Cincinnati, near Belterra Park, Coney Island and Lunken Airport.

## What customers say
- "Couldn't have asked for a better experience at Jerry Ernst Collision Center last week. They took great care of me and my 2019 Jeep Cherokee Trailhawk after it was hit while parked in a lot at Beech Acres park. I called them on a Tuesday and they were available for an estimate that same day. Work was finished Thursday evening.

When I got there Mellanie initially came out to get some info on the vehicle then Scott came out to do the estimate while I waited inside in the AC. Someone had hit a front panel below my driver side headlight and scraped and scratched it up bad (was much worse than these pics indicate). And left no note, of course. Scott came back inside and gathered an estimate within a few minutes, which was reasonable given the panel access required removing the entire front bumper and reassembling after. They were able to begin the work the very next day.

It came out absolutely flawless too. Scott said it would look better than new and it does. Extremely pleased with their work and the treatment they gave me as a customer. I wouldn't take my cars anywhere else now for body work. They are worth every penny.

I went out of pocket because the cost was lower than my deductible, but I have since updated my deductible because this is the third time in six years someone has hit one of my parked cars. Truly astonishing how oblivious drivers can be around parked cars. Good thing a place like Jerry Ernst Collision Center is around. Thank you Scott and Mellanie!" (Drew L, 5/5)
- "I had my car broken into causing tons of surrounding damage from a pry bar. TJ and Doug got me in the same day as the break-in and took about a week to fix my truck. It was a complicated fix with lots of dents, gouges and seals to repair. I am very pleased with the quality of work. They work quick and the quality is excellent. I am very particular about my cars, and the fix was identical to when it was new. Highly recommend." (Peter Settle, 5/5)
- "Greg, Scott and TJ all are great. Took care of my car and communicated with me and even worked with me on keeping it after it was completed due to being out of town. They handled everything with the insurance company and got my PPF installed by my vendor. Car looks awesome and can’t tell it’s been repaired." (Rob Trainor, 5/5)
- "They did an amazing job, were super friendly and gave me regular updates on the repair status." (Richard Ross, 5/5)
- "My review is neutral
Pros-
- super nice and wonderful personal. Office personnel were all very cool to deal with. Friendly staff!
- pricing was decent, they understandably have to make money and pay employees (supplies and tools aren’t cheap) but they do not try to gouge you on price. Very reasonable
- they deal directly with your insurance company which makes things easy

Cons
- it took to long to make the small repair on my vehicle ( they said they had personnel issues)
- the workmanship wasn’t the greatest- I can still see the dent and the jamb wasn’t finished great. Paint was decent!

Unfortunately, I did auto collision for 12 yrs so the 2 Cons are not to scare anyone way from this shop. To the average eye for bodywork, these 2 things would probably not be noticeable. My vehicle was a work van so its repairs are good enough for it.

Overall, I would say this is a decent shop to get your repairs done at. I’m not sure I would recommend if you have a high end vehicle." (Justin Lewis, 4/5)
